title: Sukuk Portfolio Analytics
thesis: Snowflake delivers real-time Sukuk portfolio intelligence — Dynamic Tables aggregate 500 holdings, ML.FORECAST projects yield curves, Iceberg shares data cross-institution, and Cortex Analyst answers portfolio questions in natural language

talking_points: RM 2.3 billion Sukuk portfolio across 500 holdings in 4 Shariah-compliant structures.
Weighted average yield at 12.3% — outperforming benchmark by 180 basis points.
Three issuers on watchlist following recent credit rating reviews.
tabs.call_out: RM 2.3B AUM — 12.3% yield, 3 issuers on watchlist

transition.line: Let's examine the portfolio structure and yield decomposition.

talking_points: Dynamic Tables rebuild yield curves every 2 hours from 50,000 market data points.
Ijara Sukuk delivering 13.1% — highest among 4 structures. Musharakah at 11.2%.
ML.FORECAST projects yield compression of 40bps over next quarter.
show: Show yield curve by structure type
tabs.call_out: ML.FORECAST predicts 40bps yield compression — rebalance signal

transition.line: Yields are projected to compress. Let's check counterparty risk.

talking_points: Three counterparties on watchlist: combined exposure RM 340M (14.8% of portfolio).
Maturity ladder shows RM 890M maturing in next 12 months — reinvestment risk.
Iceberg tables enable cross-institution risk aggregation without data movement.
tabs.call_out: RM 340M exposed to watchlist counterparties — 14.8% concentration

transition.line: Now let the CIO ask the portfolio system directly.

talking_points: Tan Sri Ahmad asks: 'What is our total exposure to BBB-rated issuers?'
Cortex Analyst queries portfolio data — returns RM 580M across 47 holdings.
Switch to advisory: 'Recommend reallocation to reduce concentration risk' — generates investment memo.
show: Switch to advisory mode for recommendation
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: portfolio analytics + investment advisory

transition.line: Every capability — native Snowflake, open Iceberg for collaboration.

talking_points: Six Snowflake capabilities, five AWS services in the dual-build architecture.
Iceberg enables cross-institution portfolio analysis without copying data.
Malaysia is the world's largest Sukuk market — 51% global share. This manages RM 2.3B.
tabs.call_out: One platform, open Iceberg, cross-institution analytics

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Islamic capital markets.
